title: PCP capabilities
description: What a connector (or one room of it) can do. Modules check these, never platform names. Declared in hello; a room.joined event may carry a narrower set for that room.

events.description: Event types this connector may emit.

actions.description: Action types this connector executes. Anything else is answered with error code 'unsupported'.

features.description: Finer-grained flags. Unknown flags are ignored.

message_ids.description: Platform gives stable message ids (needed for reply_to, react, quote).

content_elements.description: Outbound element types the connector renders natively; others are flattened to text.

private_messages.description: room = PMs travel through a room (Camfrog); global = DM channels (Discord); none.

display_markup.description: Display names may carry markup (see UserRef.display_raw).

user_id_kind.description: What UserRef.id is on this platform.

self_state_observable.description: Whether the connector can observe its own mic state, rather than inferring it from its own commands.

sticker_send_ack.description: always | sometimes | never: whether sticker.send can confirm posting. Camfrog acks only on some room servers.

platform_commands.description: Commands platform.command accepts (e.g. Camfrog slash commands).
